rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: ElevenLabs policy — free-tier accounts cannot invoke ANY library (community-shared) voice via the API, only the ~23 premade voices baked into the platform. The voice ID `ibbx9zDYGvLgtYzRbqqG` was added to this account from the shared voice library, making it a 'library voice' and therefore 402-gated. The Rachel voice (`21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM`) is now also categorized as library on this account. REPRODUCTION: `curl -H 'xi-api-key: sk_3dade0db...' -X POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/ibbx9zDYGvLgtYzRbqqG/stream -d '{"text":"hi"}'` -> 402. MITIGATION: Either (a) upgrade plan, or (b) use a premade voice ID from `/v1/voices` where category=='premade'.
